Full image layouts of enlightened and versioned control structures beyond accessed offsets.
Hardware call semantics and complete error vocabularies for trust domain operations.
Contracts of cross dossier helpers for lists, barriers, interrupts, allocation, and processor sets.
Processor capability predicates and register numbers consulted during setup.

findings.text: Enlightened VMCS first revision pin control allowlist combines mandatory always on bits with permission for external interrupt masking, NMI exiting, and virtual NMI support.

Primary execution control allowlist combines mandatory always on bits with a broad set of optional behaviors covering halt, control register access, input output, debug registers, time stamp handling, monitor and wait, paging invalidation, performance counters, interrupt windows, shadowed task priority, bitmap use, trap flags, pause, and activation of secondary controls.

Secondary execution control allowlist permits a set of modern virtualization features including virtualized extended interrupt handling, cache writeback exiting, process identifiers, extended paging, unrestricted guests, descriptor access, time stamp and identifier instructions, state extensions, random number exiting, time scaling, user wait permission, tracing address and concealment options, bus lock detection, notification exits, mode based execute control, and enclave call exiting.
Tertiary execution control allowlist and VM function control allowlist both advertise no supported features.

Exit control allowlist combines mandatory always on bits with options for saving debug state, acknowledging interrupts on exit, host address width, performance and power state save and restore, boundary configuration clearing, and tracing concealment and control handling.

Entry control allowlist combines mandatory always on bits with options for loading debug state, selecting long mode, loading performance and power state, loading boundary configuration, and tracing concealment and control handling.
Enlightened VMCS field descriptor pairs a byte offset into the image with a clean tracking slot identifier used to decide whether writeback is required.
Enlightened VMCS reads reuse the generic versioned image reader with caller supplied field identifier and offset, without distinguishing image types.

Generic versioned image read fetches the value at base plus caller supplied offset using a width derived from the field encoding, supporting natural, narrow, and wide accesses, and reports unknown widths with a one time warning plus an all bits set sentinel.
Field width decoder treats encodings with the low bit set as halves of wider values with fixed narrow width, and otherwise extracts the width selector from higher encoding bits.
Top level per processor virtualization teardown orders trust domain cleanup before generic VMX cleanup whenever trust domain extensions are enabled.
Provides per processor trust domain teardown that flushes all locally associated guests.
Trust domain teardown holds interrupts disabled across traversal of the per processor associated list and relies on safe iteration because each flush detaches its entry.

Per guest flush tolerates migration races by verifying the guest still belongs to the executing processor, skips the hardware flush for never initialized guests while still updating tracking, and records hardware failures for the caller except for the benign not associated condition.
Flush avoids console output on error because it can run in inter processor interrupt context, delegating reporting to the caller.

Guest disassociation requires interrupts disabled and orders list removal before publishing an invalid processor identifier with a write barrier, preventing another processor from re adding the guest before removal completes.
Helper recovers the enclosing trust domain vCPU structure from a pointer to its embedded generic vCPU member.
Provides per processor VMX teardown that clears loaded images, releases the virtualization reference, and resets enlightened state.

Enlightened state reset is inert when the feature is unavailable at build time or not active at runtime, and otherwise validates the assist page before clearing hypercall, current image, and entry enlightenment state to permit later plain operation.
Missing assist page during enlightened reset triggers a one time warning and aborts the reset, reflecting an invariant that enabled mode requires a page on every processor.
Local VMCS cleanup visits every image recorded on the executing processor and clears each, tolerating concurrent migration.

Image clear requires checking ownership against the executing processor, clears the current image pointer on match, removes list membership, and orders those updates before publishing invalid ownership and cleared launch state with a barrier paired to the load path.
Hardware image clear derives the physical address of the supplied image and issues the processor clear operation for it.
Top level hardware setup initializes VMX first and only proceeds to trust domain setup on success and when that mode is enabled.
Provides one time trust domain hardware setup that validates prerequisites and installs private memory and interrupt hooks.

Trust domain setup always initializes per processor tracking, then either completes enablement by enlarging VM state and installing handlers or gracefully disables the mode and reports success when the module is absent or prerequisites fail; only unexpected errors fail the load.

Inner trust domain setup validates user return register coverage, acquires global module metadata, checks attribute and feature compatibility and topology support, ensures guest limits cover present processors, and provisions key identifier capacity.

Supported trust domain attributes and extended feature sets are formed by intersecting host desires with module fixed constraints, rejecting the set entirely when any required one bit cannot be satisfied.
Provides one time VMX hardware setup that captures host state, gates optional accelerations by processor support, and configures memory, interrupt, and profiling behavior.

VMX setup retains each optional acceleration only when the processor reports its prerequisite, otherwise clearing the associated enable flag or operation hook, including identifiers, paging, access paging, interrupt virtualization, timers, and profiling.

VMX setup fails when shadow paging lacks required execute disable support and when profiling mode holds an illegal value, while unsupported profiling hardware gracefully degrades to system wide mode and warns about host boundary state loss.
Provides one time nested virtualization setup that prepares field tables, control views, shadow state, and exit handlers.

Nested setup disables shadowing when unsupported, allocates backing pages for shadow bitmaps with full cleanup on failure, initializes shadow metadata, and registers handlers for virtualization management and invalidation exits.

Shadow field setup starts from deny all bitmaps then enables only fields present in the versioned layout, validates paired halves of wide fields, skips paging log and timer fields without hardware backing, and compacts the tables while treating high halves according to word size.
Loaded image lifecycle tracks owning processor and launch state, transitioning to invalid owner and unlaunched after hardware clear.
Trust domain vCPU lifecycle distinguishes never initialized guests that skip hardware flush from initialized guests that require it, while both paths converge on detached tracking.
